title: Boston Gas Company files for approval a Firm Transportation Agreement with Salem State College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Transportation Agreements. The Department finds that the pricing terms under the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Paul B. Vasington. GC 00-01.
